null_controls.expected_false_flags_note: sum over the eligible null controls of P(p <= 0.05) under the null; with a registered target and n_ref = m + k - 1, that probability is the floor 1/(m + k) when the floor is at most 0.05

placebos.note: split-half placebos need no decoys of their own: a placebo half uses the same decoy arms as the model it splits
